name: eliot-governor
description: Connect Claude Desktop to the local ELIOT cognitive control plane.
long_description: Read current task truth, expand exact evidence, use governed memory, delegate bounded work, and submit receipted candidate or verification results through the existing local ELIOT Governor. Claude identity never grants a permanent role.

tools.name: eliot_host_session_status
tools.description: Inspect this session's task-scoped role and leases.

tools.name: eliot_project_identity
tools.description: Resolve one stable cross-host project identity.

tools.name: eliot_current_state
tools.description: Read bounded current project truth and conflicts.

tools.name: eliot_task_state
tools.description: Read the current task contract, leases, progress, and finish gaps.

tools.name: eliot_recall_l0
tools.description: Recall compact memory handles for one project.

tools.name: eliot_fetch_l2
tools.description: Expand only exact selected evidence handles.

tools.name: eliot_compile_packet_l3
tools.description: Compile one decision-local governed context packet.

tools.name: eliot_memory_influence_trace
tools.description: Record how recalled memory was used, adapted, or rejected after a local check.

tools.name: eliot_agent_candidate_submit
tools.description: Submit one novel bounded candidate with a canonical receipt.

tools.name: eliot_agent_delegate
tools.description: Delegate one separately verifiable work item under a current controller lease.

tools.name: eliot_agent_result
tools.description: Read the exact candidate result and its evidence for a delegated work item.

tools.name: eliot_agent_result_disposition
tools.description: Accept, reject, or request a probe for one candidate result under controller authority.

prompts.name: eliot-start
prompts.description: Start or resume a material task through ELIOT.
prompts.text: Start or resume ${arguments.task} through the live ELIOT task cycle. Confirm current state, task-scoped role, revision, and the smallest required packet before material action.

prompts.name: eliot-understand
prompts.text: For ${arguments.task}, separate current truth from supported, assumed, conflicted, stale, and unknown state. Expand exact handles and trace the causal path to an observable verifier.

prompts.name: eliot-delegate
prompts.description: Delegate one bounded role-leased work item.
prompts.text: For ${arguments.task}, delegate one bounded role-leased work item with exact acceptance, packet refs, expected result, verifier, and stable idempotency.

prompts.name: eliot-verify-finish
prompts.description: Verify current artifacts and finish honestly.
prompts.text: For ${arguments.task}, read exact finish gaps, run mapped verifiers against accepted artifacts, account for every acceptance item, and submit the honest completion status.
